featured_reviews.review_text:
Being in a marriage where silence replaces conversation breaks you slowly. There are no words to respond to, no fights to resolve—just long, heavy pauses that make you question your worth, your voice, and your place in the relationship. The silent treatment doesn’t shout, but it hurts louder than words.

I reached a point where the loneliness inside the marriage felt heavier than being alone. That’s when I found support through Sanjeev Mittal at Holistic Living Therapy Centre. Therapy helped me understand that this silence was not calm or maturity—it was emotional withdrawal, and it was damaging my mental and emotional well-being.

With gentle yet honest guidance, I began to heal. I learned that asking for communication is not being demanding, and wanting emotional safety is not weakness. Most importantly, I learned that silence used as punishment is a wound that needs acknowledgment, not endurance.

This journey reminded me of a painful truth: love cannot survive where voices are ignored. Healing begins when silence ends—and the right guidance can help you find your voice again.

Another city coming soon.

Children today are growing up inside powerful digital systems that shape attention, self-worth and emotional safety. Instead of reacting with outrage or blanket bans, the conversation must centre on protection. Thoughtful guardrails and digital literacy can help young people build resilience before stepping into a world designed to capture them.

I am often asked, “In a room full of testosterone, does your cortisol soar?”
Well, no but my dopamine certainly does. And toward the end, my serotonin spikes too. The only one periodically off the charts is insulin -  but yes, oxytocin will always be my favourite.
